description: enables the default permissions. NOTE: dialog:allow-confirm is listed explicitly because dialog:default does NOT include it on Tauri 2.11 — the shipped app threw 'Command plugin:dialog|confirm not allowed by ACL' on 2026-08-02, and Tauri routes window.confirm() through that command. WARNING: granting it does NOT repair the guards. Tauri's window.confirm returns a PROMISE, so `if (!confirm(...)) return` tests !Promise === false and the delete proceeds regardless. This permission only makes the dialog appear; the call sites must move to useConfirmDialog. Do not read this line as 'the confirm bug is handled'.
